resources.title: Salesforce Administrator: The Foundation Infographic (1 of 4)
resources.description: What a Salesforce Administrator actually is and does: the six core areas of the job (users & access, data management, automation, reports & dashboards, applications & features, system health), a real Northfield Retail use case (tracking leads, service cases, and automating orders), key job duties, the Salesforce platform at a glance (core apps — Sales, Service, Marketing, Experience — and the platform building blocks an admin configures), sample admin tasks, and the full career path and growth ladder from Administrator through Developer, Consultant, to Architect with real salary ranges at each step.

resources.title: Salesforce Administrator: Configuration & Automation Infographic (2 of 4)
resources.description: How a Salesforce Administrator turns business requirements into working solutions: the core configuration concepts (objects, fields, record types, page layouts, validation rules), data modeling in Salesforce (Account/Contact/Opportunity/Case relationships), building automation with Flow (trigger, get/create records, decision, action), a real case-auto-assignment example, a comparison of automation tools (Flow, Process Builder, Approval Process, Scheduled Flow) and when to use each, sample Flow pseudocode, and best practices for keeping a data model clean and automation reliable.

resources.title: Salesforce Administrator: Reporting, Dashboards & Data Infographic (3 of 4)
resources.description: Turning Salesforce data into business insights: the 5-step reporting process (capture data, build a report, create a dashboard, share insights, take action), the four key report types (tabular, summary, matrix, joined), Salesforce data management (import, clean & validate, maintain, export), security & access control (profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules), integrations & extensions (AppExchange, APIs, automation), a real sales-performance dashboard example with live metrics, and best practices for building reports around real business questions.

resources.title: Salesforce Administrator: Career, Certification, Projects & Next Steps Infographic (4 of 4)
resources.description: Turning Salesforce skills into a real job: the certification path and career progression (Administrator -> Platform App Builder -> Consultant -> Architect, with salary ranges at each level), the key Salesforce certifications and a recommended certification strategy, three real portfolio projects (user & access setup, business process automation, a sales performance dashboard), a practical 90-day action plan (build foundations, build & automate, certify & showcase, get hired), common interview questions, and the tools and resources every Salesforce admin should know (Developer Org, Trailhead, GitHub, LinkedIn, the Salesforce Community).
